experiments.scope: The 39-step compression and advice construction of sha256-r39-prefix-v1 as used by the construction (proof.md Sections 2, 10 and 11). Trial 0 runs the shipped program's Attack.claw on the published Table 23 pair (chaining value CV_PUB, a0 = A[4], u = W1) with the folded kernel built for CV_PUB, and runs verify_advice_construction(): the exact 32-bit bit-by-bit DFS fibre solver solve_row_exact on row 16 (G16) and row 17 (G17(g)), exact downward step inversion from steps 10..15 to CV_PUB (invert_downward), and enumeration of a 256-candidate local slice of the step-15 free bits. Trials 1 to 255 draw a chaining value, an even a0 and an odd u from the trial seed, recover a1, build the first message and its partner from the construction, and compare the 39-step trajectories of both with the published pair. No message pair is returned: the pair is a collision of the compression function from CV_PUB, not from the standard IV.
experiments.hypothesis: Observations (the program's own, untrusted). Trial 0: claw_returned_pair 1, passed_f9 1, passed_f8 1, passed_w17 1, pair_is_published 1, sfs_collision 1, published_w16_is_g 1, published_w17 1, kernel_records 734, claw_ops 6173, blk_census 149, g16_fibre_size 2, g17_fibre_size 1, fibre_dfs_ops 1944 (< 2812 = 1 compression), downward_inv_ok 1, advice_slice_cands 256, advice_slice_hits 1, ops_per_cand 408 (< 4 * 2812 = 4 compressions). Trials 1 to 255: transplant_ok 1 (the states A[6..19] and E[10..19] of both messages equal the published ones), w1_is_u 1, w16_identity 1 (W16 - g = F(u) - F(a0) mod 2^32) on all 255. Returned pairs: 0 of 256.

experiments.scope: Trial 0 runs one window of the shipped program (folded 256-lane kernel, every parameter of class P unchanged: DP = low 7 bits zero, table 26,112 words, queue 4096, stage 2 as in proof.md Section 3) on a first block drawn from the trial seed, cut to 2^22 walk evaluations (16,384 iterations of 256 lanes) instead of 2^26, in check mode: every raw claw is asserted to satisfy F(a0) = F(u), a0 even, u odd and W16 = g by the construction (build and expand). Trials 1 to 255 return nothing. No message pair is returned. The generator is charged at its halt cap 575,000 operators because the sandbox has no WebAssembly runtime.
experiments.hypothesis: Observations (the program's own, untrusted), trial 0: iterations 16384, dp_hits 32865, matches 1705, stage2_iterations 2892, raw_claws 836, opposite_parity 836, distinct_claws 807, distinct_groups 807, passed_f9 11, passed_f8 0, passed_w17 0, kernel_records 741, ops 24291337 (generator 580928 of them), blk_census 664 (together with trial 0's 70-op claw_w17 block, 664 + 70 = 734 executed-block instructions). No assertion fails. The window is 1/16 of the program's window, so its operations per claw are not the ledger value of proof.md Section 5. Returned pairs: 0 of 256. Not shown: a full-size window, the tail, any cost.

experiments.scope: Tail replica of proof Section 8 (run 1 of 14): trial 0 runs the SMC over E18..E23 of the carrier K_P (500 particles) with a known-answer check on the published pair; trials 1 to 10 draw W8 in F8 and W9 in F9 for every proposal (30 x 2048 each), rebuild rows 24 to 38 and verify every hit by the two 39-step compressions. Returns no message pair.
experiments.hypothesis: Observations (the program's own): trial 0 kat 1, mask_viol 0, stage counts k18..k23 and log2_carrier; trials 1 to 10 hits, verified (= hits) and parity classes. Over the 14 runs with the public seeds: 601 hits in 8,601,600 proposals, 601 verified; mean log2 Q' = -75.393, one-sided 99% Student lower bound -75.592 (proof Section 8).
